sentence: This project studies how feeling socially disconnected is related to thoughts of suicide in older adults.
This project offers ways to measure the chemicals made by cells and the work of mitochondria to help understand how aging works.
This project studies how cell signaling controls the growth of organs and tissues, using the fruit fly Drosophila melanogaster.
This project tries to find out which molecular pathways linked to autism cause changes in the brain and behavior in zebrafish.
This project studies how chronic stress may change the link between disease traits and survival in women with endometrial cancer.
This project uses genomics and computer methods to find out how fast groups of blood cells with DNA mutations grow in older people.
This project studies how myelinating cells in the brain respond to signals from their surroundings and how that could help myelin regenerate.
This project builds a robotic device that can steer deeper into the lungs of critically ill children to collect samples with less fluid.
This project studies how lipid droplet proteins control lipid metabolism and how problems with them affect energy balance and tissue regeneration.
This project combines immunology with engineering principles.
This project studies how the Foxp2 protein shapes gene activity and electrical activity in the parts of the brain that process sound.
This project studies how conventional dendritic cells help T cells become activated against glioblastoma, a type of brain tumor.
This project tests whether rapidly changing bacterial genes help bacteria settle in the gut microbiome.
This project provides equipment and expertise, including mass spectrometry imaging, for research on metals in biology and medicine.
This project builds micro-capsule technology to screen and map how cells interact with one another.
This project studies how exposure to violence, stress and other risks and protective factors are linked to firearm injury.
This project studies how transfer RNAs affect the body's defense in acute lung injury and how an enzyme controls them.
This project studies how special channels in the kidney help control the amount of potassium released.
This project studies how aging T cells contribute to Alzheimer's disease and looks for ways to block that aging.
This project studies how a signaling protein shapes the immune response inside breast tumors and tests treatments that combine immunotherapy with chemotherapy.
